Import objects from a file (YAML or JSON array).

Examples:
  # Create new objects only (skip existing)
  zqk object import --file items.yaml --mode create_only
  # Create or update by ID
  zqk object import --file items.json --mode upsert
  # Validate without writing
  zqk object import --file items.yaml --dry-run

Usage:
  zqk object import [flags]

Flags:
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --continue-on-error       Continue importing other objects even if one fails
      --dry-run                 Validate without writing
      --file string             Path to YAML or JSON file to import
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
      --input-format string     Input format (yaml, json)
      --mode string             Import mode (create_only, upsert) (default "create_only")
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
